Research guide / AI structure auditing

Detecting structure
is not the same as
recovering meaning.

VARZIN treats morphology, clustering, semantic-axis recovery, explicit training effects, and held-out composition as distinct questions. The purpose of the audit is to prevent success on one task from being promoted into evidence for another.

LLM evaluationLUXVARNegative results retained
Current conclusion

Some tested procedures recover surface or morphemic structure, while direct frozen-model tests did not recover the intended semantic axes. Later targeted training is a separate intervention, not evidence of spontaneous recovery.

01 / separation

Four questions that must not be collapsed.

Surface

Morphology

Do strings contain designed, non-random morphemic or phonotactic regularities under the specified controls?

Grouping

Clustering

Do models or algorithms produce stable groupings, and what labels or structure do those groups actually track?

Meaning

Semantic-axis recovery

Do outputs align with the intended axes without being given those axes through supervision or projection?

Interpretive rule: agreement between models, good classification accuracy, or non-random morphology does not by itself demonstrate independent recovery of intended semantics.

02 / direct tests

What the frozen-model audit found.

01

Historical inter-model agreement

The LUXVAR preprint reports Claude/Gemini cluster ARI = 0.812 as inter-model surface or morpheme agreement. The project correction explicitly warns that this should not be read as semantic-axis recovery, and the raw pairwise scoring was not independently re-verified at correction time.

02

Track D negative result

The later frozen, unremediated test reports Mistral 7B ARI = −0.0337 and Llama 3 8B ARI = 0.0152 against intended axis/orbit labels. Under that protocol, the intended axes were not recovered.

03

String-level semantic tests

SEM-001 reported no semantic-axis signal at string level. SEM-002 scored 1/4 against a criterion of at least 2/4, so the criterion was not met.

03 / interventions

Explicit training changes the question.

Later project documentation reports strong targeted recovery after explicit training or projection. Those experiments can be meaningful as representation-learning results, but they are not evidence that frozen models independently discovered the intended LUXVAR axes.

What can be reported

  • Targeted training can recover labels or group position under the documented procedures.
  • Representation recovery and group-position classification are distinct measurable tasks.
  • Negative frozen-model results remain valid for the earlier unremediated protocol.

What should not be inferred

  • That training proves spontaneous semantic emergence.
  • That group-position classification is the same as composition.
  • That one negative experiment proves all language models fail at algebra.
  • That project-designed labels are independently validated by recovery after supervision.
04 / composition

Representation success did not settle composition.

The documented experimental record distinguishes Appendix F group-position classification from Appendix G held-out composition. Appendix G reports seen performance of 0.996 but TRUE 0.106, SHUFFLED 0.281 and WRONG_OP 0.175 in the stated procedure; V2 Qwen Phase2 separately reports 0/58 passes. These are scoped negative results, not universal claims about LLM algebra.

05 / primary record

Read the audit with its limits intact.

The project-listed record Morphemes vs. Manifolds: Diagnosing Structural Blindness and Morphological Hijacking in Large Language Models via Finite Affine Orbits is the central publication for this line of work.

A

VARZIN V2 — Recoverable but Not Composable

Representation recovery and systematic composition are treated as separate questions. The version-specific public record is 10.5281/zenodo.22679978.

B

Morphological Hijacking projection-head series

Public v1, v2 and v3 records document the contrastive, symmetry-regularized projection-head line: v1, v2, and v3. These are explicit intervention records and should not be conflated with spontaneous recovery in an unmodified frozen model.
